svg.aria-label: Version A. Upper voice: E4 4 to 10 s, F4 14 to 20 s, E4 26 to 32 s (rests in between). Lower voice: C4 0 to 36 s. Version B. Upper voice: E4 4 to 10 s, F4 14 to 20 s, E4 26 to 32 s (rests in between). Lower voice: C4 0 to 12 s, B3 12 to 24 s, C4 24 to 36 s. The upper voice is identical in both versions.
svg.title: Two 36-second sketches: same upper line, different lower line

g.text: How to read this graphic: Each timeline is 36 seconds wide. Upper lane first, lower lane
below. Solid bars are notes, dashed boxes are rests. Compare the two upper lanes: they
match exactly. Then compare the two lower lanes: Version A holds one note, Version B
